vocab.meaning_vi: hành động (phần A trong STAR: bạn đã làm gì)
vocab.example: In the action part, focus on what you did, not what the team did.
vocab.example_vi: Ở phần hành động, hãy tập trung vào việc bạn làm, không phải việc cả nhóm làm.

vocab.example: My approach was to talk to each user group before changing the design.
vocab.example_vi: Cách tiếp cận của tôi là nói chuyện với từng nhóm người dùng trước khi thay đổi thiết kế.

vocab.example: I broke down the big task into small steps for each team member.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi chia nhỏ nhiệm vụ lớn thành các bước nhỏ cho từng thành viên.

vocab.example: I took the initiative to write a guide for new team members.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đã chủ động viết một tài liệu hướng dẫn cho thành viên mới.

vocab.meaning_vi: chủ động (hành động trước khi có vấn đề)
vocab.example: I was proactive and warned the client about the delay two weeks early.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đã chủ động báo trước cho khách về việc chậm trễ từ hai tuần trước.

vocab.example: My main contribution was building the reporting feature.
vocab.example_vi: Đóng góp chính của tôi là xây dựng tính năng báo cáo.

vocab.example: Can you give me a concrete example of how you handled pressure?
vocab.example_vi: Bạn có thể cho tôi một ví dụ cụ thể về cách bạn xử lý áp lực không?

vocab.example: After the change, we saw a thirty percent improvement in response time.
vocab.example_vi: Sau thay đổi, thời gian phản hồi cải thiện được ba mươi phần trăm.

listening.title: Answering a behavioral question with STAR

lines.speaker: Hạnh (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: Thanks, Khoa. Now, can you tell me about a time you improved a process at work?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: Sure. At my last company, our support team answered customer tickets very slowly. The average time was two days.

lines.speaker: Hạnh (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: What was your role in that situation?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: I was a team lead. My manager asked me to reduce the response time to under one day within three months.

lines.speaker: Hạnh (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: And what did you do? Please be as concrete as possible.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: First, I broke down the tickets by type. I found that forty percent were the same five questions.

lines.speaker: Hạnh (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: Interesting. So what was your approach?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: I took the initiative to write ready-made answers for those questions and trained the team to use them.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Candidate)
lines.text: After two months, the average response time was six hours. That was a big improvement, and customer ratings went up too.

options: The support team answered tickets slowly
The team did not have a leader

questions.q: What was the average response time after two months?

shadowing: The situation was that our team answered customer tickets very slowly, about two days.
My task was to cut the response time to under one day within three months.
I broke down the tickets by type and wrote ready-made answers for common questions.
As a result, our average response time dropped to six hours in two months.
My main contribution was finding the pattern and training the team to use it.
